description: Dependency types whose NeoForge 1.21.1 build exposes a HolderLookup.Provider accessor (javap of the 1.21.1 jars). accessor is appended to a parameter of that type, or used on `this` by a class extending or implementing it.

carriers.notes: ponder-neoforge-1.0.87+mc1.21.1: SceneBuilder#world() returns WorldInstructions, which gained getHolderLookupProvider() (absent in Ponder-Forge-1.20.1-1.0.91)
neoforge-21.1.133: IPayloadContext#player() is the receiving player of a play-phase payload (the server player, or the client's local player), whose Entity#registryAccess() is that side's registries

ponder-neoforge-1.0.87+mc1.21.1 (bundles Catnip): AbstractSimiScreen extends net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen, whose public getMinecraft() is the client; its level holds the client registries while a screen is open in a world
